strategy: Replace ripple chain with balanced binary tree
rationale: 512 dependent XOR stages collapse to 9 when rebalanced as a binary tree. XOR associativity guarantees identical results. Depth from 512 → 9 saves ~58 gate delays.
area_cost: none — same gate count, only topology changes
equivalence_argument: XOR is associative. The serial chain computes parity left-to-right; the balanced tree computes the same parity with intermediate groups XORed in parallel, then combined. All 512 input bits, same single-bit output, no truncation. Reset: par_chain had no register, only driven by xd_q and constants, so reset unchanged.
